duration: As stated in the agreement or to be refined in review.
effective_date: Upon full execution by the parties unless otherwise specified.
payment_terms: To be agreed between the parties (add specifics in review if compensation applies).
purpose: I run a small landscaping company and need something in writing with a homeowner because the project keeps changing. It started as mowing and cleanup, then became mulch beds, tree trimming, sprinkler repairs, hauling debris, and possible monthly maintenance if they like the result. They text late-night add-ons, want “small extras” included for free, and keep changing priorities while I’m already on site. I want something professional and fair that clearly covers original scope, added work approval, pricing for extras, deposits, weather delays, damage to hidden irrigation lines or underground items I wasn’t told about, payment due dates, photo use of the finished yard, and an easy way for both sides to review changes before final approval or signing.
title: Agreement
